¿Qué país me recomendáis para un primer: Which country would you recommend for a first safari?
Namibia o Sudáfrica. Son fáciles de viaj: Namibia or South Africa. They are easy to travel to, they have a huge number of species and there are short programmes at a good price. Namibia is also ideal if you are travelling with your family.
¿Cuánto cuesta un safari de caza en Áfri: How much does a hunting safari in Africa cost?
Depende mucho del país, de los días y de: It depends a great deal on the country, the number of days and what you hunt. A plains game safari can come in at a few thousand euros; a buffalo or a leopard in wild country costs considerably more. Each programme shows its starting price, and you can work out your own figure with the budget calculator.
¿Puedo llevar mi rifle?: Can I take my own rifle?
Sí, y es lo más habitual. Nosotros trami: Yes, and most hunters do. We handle the temporary import permit. For buffalo and elephant a .375 is normally the minimum.
¿Cómo traigo el trofeo a España?: How do I get my trophy home?
Lo coordinamos con el taxidermista y el: We coordinate it with the taxidermist and the shipping agent, including CITES permits when the species needs them. You don't have to worry about a thing.
Claro. Todos los programas tienen precio: Of course. Every programme has an observer rate, and many hunting areas offer photographic safaris and excursions for them.
Llevamos más de treinta años organizando: We have been organising hunting safaris in Africa for more than thirty years. Buffalo, leopard, lion, elephant or a good week of plains game: we only send you to hunting grounds we know, because we have hunted there ourselves first.

¿Dónde se caza el Marco Polo?: Where do you hunt Marco Polo?
Lo organizamos en el Pamir de Tayikistán: We organise it in the Pamirs of Tajikistan and the Tian Shan of Kyrgyzstan. In Tajikistan the success rate over the last twelve years has been one hundred per cent.
¿Hace falta estar muy en forma?: Do I need to be very fit?
For the mountains, yes. You hunt above 3,000 metres, on foot and on horseback. For boar in Turkey or bear from a hide, far less so.
¿Cuál es el íbex más fácil de cazar?: Which is the easiest ibex to hunt?
El bezoar de Turquía es una buena puerta: The Turkish bezoar is a good way in: fine trophies of 100 to 110 cm, and a straightforward trip from Spain.
¿Se pueden traer los trofeos de Asia a E: Can trophies from Asia be brought home?
Sí. Nos encargamos de los permisos de ex: Yes. We handle the export and import permits, including CITES when the species requires it.
